description: Required core approval-exchange and request-closure behavior within a retained live context. Unless a case says otherwise, messages pass verification, authorization, and structural checks, and sending slots are resolved before later messages are sent. O is an approval originator, A its intended authority peer, P an approval request, D a decision, and K a closure. Their labels stand for message or principal identities, not wire values. The cases require semantic checking and do not establish implementation conformance or restart guarantees. Unless a step states otherwise, conversation traffic uses an explicitly selected applicable continuity profile with valid authorized guards and retained required context at admission; stale traffic from an ended scope is rejected at that boundary before ordinary correlation or disposition handling.

cases.name: an actor requester initiates an independent approval exchange

steps.event: executor O creates conversation C with authority actor A and sends approval P as its first message, without in_response_to, describing the exact action, deadline, and bound_required true
expect: P can initiate the exchange without say, taken, or an open turn
O owns P's pending state and deadline
the conversation remains identified by A and C in both directions

steps.event: A accepts P
expect: ack P
no permission is established by the acknowledgement

steps.event: A sends signed decide D naming P, with approve true and the digest of P's exact signed bytes; O accepts it while P is pending before its deadline
expect: ack D
O retains one accepted decision
O emits closed K naming P with why decided
no result or work turn is created for P

steps.event: A accepts K
expect: ack K
the approval exchange is closed
closure does not establish execution of the authorized action
O need not await ack K to use the accepted permission under its application contract

cases.name: approval ownership is independent of principal kind and conversation role

steps.event: party requester O originates P toward actor A without an open turn; A's valid decision is accepted by O
expect: O acknowledges the decision and emits closed decided
party identity does not exclude approval lifecycle ownership

steps.event: in a separate conversation, answering actor O originates approval Q toward its requester, which may be a party or actor; the valid decision is accepted by O
expect: O acknowledges the decision and emits closed decided
the same originator-owned lifecycle applies in the opposite conversation direction

cases.name: several approvals can remain pending independently of a work turn

steps.event: turn S is open; independently identified approvals P and Q are accepted and acknowledged in the same conversation
expect: P and Q do not join or consume S's response obligation
each approval retains its own originator, deadline, and disposition
acknowledged pending approvals do not keep their message delivery slots occupied

steps.event: P receives an accepted decision
expect: P closes as decided
Q remains pending
S remains open until its own result or targeted stop

cases.name: denial is a decision and not automatically a work result

steps.event: O has pending P and an application operation whose work may depend on permission
an authorized bound decide D with approve false is accepted before P's deadline
expect: ack D
closed for P with why decided
P's accepted decision records denial
closed decided alone does not mean permission was granted
the application operation determines its work outcome; no automatic terminal result is created by the approval exchange

cases.name: originator expiry wins over an earlier sent but later received decision

steps.event: A sends a correctly bound decision D before P's stated deadline; transport delays D
O's deadline passes while P is pending
expect: O records P as expired
O emits closed naming P with why expired
no permission is accepted for P

steps.event: D arrives after O has expired P
expect: refusal closed for D
D's sent_at does not reopen P
P remains expired

cases.name: accepted decisions are stable and deadline expiry is not grant expiry

steps.event: O accepts valid grant D while P is pending before its deadline
expect: ack D
retain D as P's accepted decision
closed for P with why decided

steps.event: P's decision deadline later passes or O's work is abandoned
expect: P remains decided
no expired or withdrawn transition replaces the accepted decision
withdrawing a request cannot revoke its already accepted grant
the authorization contract determines permitted use and grant validity; P's decision deadline is not automatically grant expiry

steps.event: an identical D arrives again, followed by a different decision D2 for P
expect: duplicate acknowledgement for D without another decision
refusal closed for D2
accepted D remains unchanged

cases.name: only the originator determines approval expiry

steps.event: A's local clock has passed P's advertised deadline, but A has received no owner closure
expect: A's clock does not establish O's terminal disposition
A cannot issue closed expired as P's owner
no authority or execution outcome is inferred from the missing closure

steps.event: O's authenticated closed expired arrives
expect: ack the closure
retain P as expired
do not solicit or apply a new decision for P

cases.name: work termination does not implicitly withdraw an approval

steps.event: O has pending approval P correlated to work turn S by in_response_to or caused_by; S completes or is stopped
expect: S's closure does not itself close P
correlation does not create approval lifecycle ownership or a cancellation dependency
P does not move to a newer work turn

steps.event: O's application policy explicitly withdraws pending P because the work is abandoned
expect: O records P as withdrawn and emits closed withdrawn
a later new decision for P is refused closed
an already accepted grant could not have been changed by this withdrawal

cases.name: a delayed correlated approval remains an independent exchange

steps.event: O sends P with in_response_to naming known turn S; S closes and newer turn N opens before P arrives; no closure for P was issued
P arrives
expect: P is handled as its own approval exchange
the correlation to known S is not an instruction to join N or reopen S
N's response obligation and completion are unchanged

steps.event: a separate new approval Q carries an unknown in_response_to reference
expect: refusal unknown for Q under ordinary correlation rules
a sender initiating an uncorrelated exchange can omit in_response_to instead

cases.name: decision authority and exact request binding are checked before acceptance

steps.event: P is pending with bound_required true; a decision from the configured authority peer passes scope and authentication checks but current action policy does not authorize that peer to decide P
expect: refusal not-authorized
no accepted decision or closure of P

steps.event: an authorized decision names P with the wrong digest
expect: refusal wrong-request
P remains pending

steps.event: an authorized decision names P without its required digest
expect: refusal unbound-decision
P remains pending

steps.event: a new authorized decision with matching binding is accepted before P expires
expect: ack the decision
one accepted decision and owner-issued closed decided

cases.name: decisions cannot create approvals or target other message kinds

steps.event: a decision names an approval identity absent from the originator's retained context
expect: refusal unknown
no reconstruction of an approval or grant

steps.event: a decision names a known question or opening say instead of an approval
expect: refusal malformed
no inferred approval from the target or its turn

steps.event: a new decision names a known expired or withdrawn approval
expect: refusal closed
no reopening or acceptance of permission

cases.name: known request closure requires its authenticated originator and compatible reason

steps.event: P is a known approval from O and Q is a known question from its actor originator
In each target's valid conversation, its non-owning configured peer sends closed back to the request originator for P or Q; the signed participants and conversation match the receiving guard
expect: refusal not-authorized
no change to the target's lifecycle

steps.event: O sends closed answered for P, or Q's owner sends closed decided for Q
expect: refusal malformed for the incompatible closure
no change to the target's lifecycle

steps.event: an otherwise authorized closed names a known say, result, or other non-request message
expect: refusal malformed
no inferred closure of its turn

cases.name: an approval closure overtaking its request prevents later admission

steps.event: O sends P, but its delivery remains unconfirmed; O withdraws P locally and explicitly releases P's sending slot before sending closed K with why withdrawn
K reaches A before P
expect: ack K
retain a provisional terminal marker scoped to this conversation, authenticated originator O, peer, and P's ID
no approval, turn, decision, or grant is reconstructed

steps.event: otherwise valid P from O to the same peer arrives
expect: ack P
retain P already closed as withdrawn
never open or present P for decision
no new work or permission follows from the delayed request

steps.event: identical P arrives again
expect: duplicate acknowledgement
P remains closed

cases.name: a question closure overtaking its request prevents a stale prompt

steps.event: actor O's question Q is delayed; its notification attempts exhaust and its slot is released; O sends closed expired for Q
the requester receives the closure first
expect: ack the closure
retain a scoped provisional closure for Q
do not reconstruct Q or its turn

steps.event: otherwise valid Q arrives from O
expect: ack Q
retain Q already expired
do not present Q as answerable or reopen its turn

cases.name: provisional closure is scoped and rejects incompatible later targets

steps.event: a valid owner-issued closed decided for unseen P has established a marker
the same originator supplies P in the same scope as a question or an opening say
expect: refusal malformed because the asserted closure and target kind are incompatible
no new actionable request or work starts for that conflicting target
the retained closure is not silently discarded

steps.event: a request is evaluated in another conversation or under a different authenticated originator or peer
expect: this marker has no authority over that request
apply that request's ordinary validation and context rules
no cancellation inferred solely from an equal unscoped ID

cases.name: closure duplicates are harmless and contradictory terminal reports are refused

steps.event: a receiver accepts owner-issued closed K for P with why withdrawn
identical K is delivered again
expect: duplicate acknowledgement
no second terminal transition

steps.event: the same owner sends a new closure ID reporting P as withdrawn
expect: ack the new closure
preserve the same terminal disposition

steps.event: the same owner sends a new closure reporting P as decided or expired
expect: refusal malformed
the original withdrawn disposition remains authoritative

cases.name: closure is not a grant and sending a decision is not its acceptance

steps.event: A sends grant D for P but receives no acknowledgement or other evidence establishing acceptance
expect: A cannot claim that O accepted D or executed the action

steps.event: in a separate exchange, an authorized owner closure with why decided arrives before the request or decision details are available
expect: retain the closure without reconstructing a grant
closed decided does not disclose approve true or false
no claim about which decision was accepted or whether the action executed

cases.name: expiry and withdrawal do not create a delivery-slot bypass

steps.event: O's P is pending while an ordinary message from O occupies its sending slot; P expires locally
expect: P becomes expired at O without waiting for closure delivery
closed expired follows ordinary sending-slot rules
there is no additional control slot for approval closure

steps.event: a decision reaches O before its queued closure can be delivered
expect: refusal closed
lack of delivered closure does not reopen locally expired P

steps.event: the held sending slot is acknowledged, terminally refused, or explicitly released
expect: the closure can be sent under ordinary delivery rules
explicit release does not establish non-delivery of the earlier message

cases.name: closure from an unauthorized sender cannot reserve an unseen request identity

steps.event: a closed message names unseen P, but verification or authorization for that sender and conversation fails
expect: the applicable verification or authorization refusal
no prospective terminal marker for P
no authority inferred from knowledge of P's identity

steps.event: a valid P subsequently arrives
expect: the failed closure attempt does not affect P's admission
apply P's ordinary exchange rules

cases.name: the deadline is checked at acceptance even before an expiry callback runs

steps.event: P remains marked pending because its expiry callback has not run; a valid authorized decision arrives at or after the deadline on O's current clock
O processes the decision
expect: compare O's current clock with P's deadline
P becomes expired
refusal closed for the decision
O issues closed expired
a stale pending flag cannot admit permission after the deadline

cases.name: an unconfirmed outgoing decision does not prevent a valid owner expiry

steps.event: A has sent granting decision D but received no evidence that O accepted it
A receives authenticated owner-issued closed expired for P
expect: ack the closure
P is retained as expired
A's earlier act of sending D is not a conflicting accepted decision

steps.event: in a separate retained exchange, acceptance of a granting decision was already confirmed; the owner reports a contradictory expired closure
expect: refusal malformed for the contradictory closure
preserve the accepted decision and its decided disposition
no revocation inferred from request expiry

cases.name: retaining another participant's approval does not confer originator ownership

steps.event: authority A has received and retained approval P originated by O in their conversation
Originator O sends a structurally valid decision addressed to A referencing P in their active conversation; the message passes its participant and scope guard
expect: refusal not-authorized because A did not originate P
A cannot accept a decision or issue owner closure for P
P's originator O remains responsible for decision acceptance

steps.event: Separately, a new decision is signed for and reaches O in a different properly established active conversation where P is unknown
expect: refusal unknown
no cross-conversation lookup or ownership inferred solely from P's ID

cases.name: bilateral exchanges preserve conversation identity and require unambiguous keys

steps.event: A is requester in an existing B-owned conversation with key C and now wants a separate A-owned conversation with requester B
expect: the new conversation must use a different fresh key
reversing roles does not change the actor identity of existing C

steps.event: an approval or owner-issued closure in C arrives from either participant
expect: resolve the authenticated peer and key to the existing context
use its recorded conversation actor B
do not infer a new A-owned context from message kind or direction

steps.event: a receiver detects conflicting retained contexts for the same peer and key
expect: refusal malformed before applying the message
no choice based on current turn or transport connection
no claim that a first-frame key collision is always detectable from the payload

cases.name: independent approval state has only the core live-context lifetime

steps.event: O had pending or decided P, or A retained a closure-before-request marker, and the required state in provisioned C1 is lost
expect: invalidate the local admission guard before replacement state or further admission
core requires no restoration of the approval, accepted decision or closure marker
state loss proves neither permission nor non-execution
no automatic replay or resubmission is assumed safe

steps.event: An original decision signed for C1 reaches the retired guard or a fresh C2 channel
expect: generic binding rejection: close the original associated connection with WebSocket code 1008 if still open, otherwise discard without response; no identifying close-reason details
no core disposition, new semantic handling or reservation of the presented message ID
do not create or recreate a conversation from the frame

steps.event: A separately authorized new decision signed for properly established C2 names P, which C2 does not retain
expect: refusal unknown
no recreation of P or C1 from the decision
same-scope restoration requires another explicitly applicable profile and complete restored basis before ingress
